reviews.comment: Diversity remains the lens, and the run still has none. Six English phones, the same three names, three identical claims, zero refusals; the harness matches English sentences, so a non-English pod cannot be run at all. That matters more now, because seventy new lexicon keys ship with an English default and no translation in any of the thirty-two language files, while forty-five sibling pod keys are translated, so a German member would read half a screen. The card obeys one derivation, the waits name who is pending, the receipt reconciles, and the copy reports failure. But the witness screen still prints the raw double, and Ready sits above six undecided controls.

reviews.fixedFromRound1: Two of my eight classes are closed at the class. **The run that certifies the change now exercises it** (round-1 blocker): `guideIs`/`guideGo` at frontend/scripts/pod-live-run-2026-09-11.mjs:66-67 produce 27 guide assertions across three phones and six phases (docs/assessments/pod-live-run-2026-09-12-asm/log.txt, 2155ms → 35380ms), the withheld control is read back as disabled on the joiner's phone (log 10987ms, 12645ms, 34599ms), and the next-field mark is read out of the DOM rather than from source. **"Copy the receipt" now copies the receipt**: page.tsx:722 reads `[data-testid="pod-receipt"]`, which at page.tsx:1635 wraps Completed, receipt-3, Intent/Outcome/Recorded and the four artefacts, and a failed copy says so (page.tsx:1639). Three more advanced but are not closed at the class: the guide's derivation (mySeats at page.tsx:637, `x.active` split, every `wait()` naming who at page.tsx:642, controls disabled at 1250/1311/1610 — but the roster at ACTIVE still reads "✓ ready" for all three under a WAITING card, page.tsx:711 vs 4-active-ready-ana.jpg); the outcome-as-fact claim (pod-synthesis.ts:133 now says "Whether it was met is for the record and the witnesses below" and :145-149 gives the accelerator's reason — but fmtGps at page.tsx:138-140 still documents "two decimals" and ships `toFixed(4)`); and the lexicon (28 keys added with every englishDefault preserved verbatim — but `soi.pod.guide.*` and `soi.pod.ui.*` have zero translations in any file, and ~34 visible strings still bypass `t()`). Three are not fixed: the machine-voice class, the unasserted-run-line class, and — worst — the ONE-PRECISION class, which the same commits claim as fixed and which the same commits' screenshot refutes.
reviews.forward: Forward 1→10 the guided path now holds for a stranger: at every phase the card is one derivation, a wait names the person it waits on, the control the card withholds is disabled on that phone, and the harness proves this on three phones instead of asserting it against the source. It breaks at step 6 of 7 — the audit screen prints `0.013788333333333333 witnessed hours` and `reference e628175b` to all three members (page.tsx:1600,1605,1568; docs/assessments/pod-live-run-2026-09-12-asm/7-audit-witness-lead.jpg) — and it breaks at every screen for a member who is not reading English, because neither new key family has a single translation. Downstream at Cube 10 the certificate is still part narration: 26 of 69 `step()` calls take the `ok = true` default.
reviews.backward: Backward 10→1 the receipt reconciles for the first time: 3.0000 planned, 0.0138 counted, Δ -2.9862 h, 웃 0.066, three seats at 0.0046 h → 웃 0.022 each, and the USA-equivalent line takes the route the validator prescribed for each seat (walkthrough.json; log 36293ms). Tracing back from the copy to the source, the four artefacts sit outside every precision rule the page just adopted (page.tsx:780,783 print raw floats into the text a member carries away), and the run log still labels 341 words a "333-word synthesis" (pod-live-run-2026-09-11.mjs:194) after the page's own claim was softened and gated. Back at Cube 1, a joiner told "Waiting for the lead to seat you" still has the lead's live Intent, Outcome, name and "Share QR & open the pod" beneath the card (page.tsx:643 vs 901-1000).

reviews.comment: Enlil, on build verification. The run now drives what it certifies: twenty-seven guide assertions across three phones, the withheld control read back as disabled, the next-field mark read from the DOM. The copy carries the whole receipt. The synthesis no longer states the target as fact. That is real class work.
